post_diagnostic_guard_change: Unused derived-buffer exception removed before deployment; shipped loader requires complete parameter AND buffer coverage. No actual checkpoint had missing/unexpected keys in the diagnostic; fresh main execution confirmed the stricter guard.

cost_comparison.scope: List-price normalized model, not an invoice or measured end-to-end baseline. Memory is fixed at 16/32/64 GiB for sensitivity. Diagnostic common time includes snapshot/capture overhead; excludes startup/queue/network/idle. Actual Modal charges max(request, usage), and host/ordering effects are not isolated.

api_cold_sensitivity.interpretation: Cold API non-export time reused in the frozen-input cost model. Not a paired whole-asset run or actual bill: API geometry/UV differed, startup before running_gpu is excluded. CPU 4/8 are near break-even; CPU8 is the lower-latency choice, not a universal cost minimum.

selected_production_policy.decision: Latency-oriented; CPU4/8 costs are near break-even with cold API overhead. Not a universal minimum-cost claim.

limitations: Single prepared SV shoe; not MV/1536/T4 acceptance
Sequential full-init/no-init loads have different file/kernel cache states; neural timing delta is not a no-init inference speedup
CPU tiers used separate allocations and two repetitions, not fully interleaved controlled hosts
UV topology preservation is not identical UV coordinates, image quality or final GLB byte parity
Inpaint pixel equivalence applies to the same frozen inputs; full export can generate different intermediate geometry
Actual native image imported OpenCV 5.0.0 despite declared 4.12 headless dependency; no fully hermetic Python dependency claim
Published normalized costs are not invoice measurements; RAM/cold-start/host/geometry affect comparisons
Production retains native auto kernel selection; diagnostic bit-exactness does not establish global determinism
private_data_policy: Inputs, credentials, account financial data, tensor/chart/inpaint fixtures, full traces and GLBs/renders are not committed.
